main_text.head: IVDÆORUM PASCHATA.
main_text.l: Cycl. Judaic. | Anni à Christo nato. | PASCHA. | Lit.dom. | Cyclus Iudaicus. | Anni à Christo nato. | PASCHA. | Lit.dom.
main_text.p: Annis cycli Iudaici 2. 5. 10, 13. 16. 18. Pascha Iudaicum antevertit priscam Tekuphama Iudæorum, sive diem 25. Martij. Sed non prævenit Tekuphama Alfonsinam quam Iudei attribuunt suo Rabbi Adda. quæ fixa est in 14. Martij ut habet Calendarium Palestinum Venetiis excusum typis Hebraicis anno Iudaico 5335.

page.notes: Marginal note at left beside the table, rotated, reads: "Pasc. seper Mense Mart. aut Apr." Column of Lit.dom. letters on the right of the table is printed in two blocks. Some letters of the table (Tekupham, Iudæorum) are reproduced as best read; "Tekupham" in the paragraph is printed as "Tekupham". Catchword-line at foot right: "CAP. XV." Signature at foot left faint ("E 3").
